alternatives.text: Pip the rabbit reaches to smooth one sticky note onto the toy cabinet's bare front panel, but it clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip pinches the note with the other paw to peel it free, and it splits into two notes, one stuck to each paw. Pip slaps both paws toward the cabinet, but the notes bounce back and double into four, fluttering up Pip's arms. Pip shakes both arms hard to fling the four notes away, and they split into eight, plastering Pip's chest and cheeks. Pip freezes, watching the eight notes ripple and settle, and realizes that every removal or transfer attempt multiplies the notes. Pip deliberately stops struggling and stands still, letting the notes rest. A sneeze bursts out of Pip, and the blast peels the notes off and scatters them across the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.

alternatives.text: Pip the rabbit presses one sticky note toward the toy cabinet's empty front panel, but it clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip tries to flick the note off with a quick wrist snap, and it splits into two notes, one on each paw. Pip claps both paws together to crush the notes flat, but they spring apart into four and climb Pip's sleeves. Pip backs away and brushes the four notes off against the cabinet's side, and they split into eight, wrapping Pip's shoulders and muzzle. Pip stares at the doubling notes, breathing hard, and realizes that every removal or transfer attempt multiplies the notes. Pip slowly lowers both arms and stops moving entirely, letting the notes cling. A sneeze jerks through Pip, and the notes blow off in a burst and land across the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.
